summary: Fuel Ventures is a UK venture investor operating SEIS and EIS funds for early-stage technology companies. Its Founders page says the funds have invested in more than 161 concept and pre-seed companies and 99 seed to Series A companies, and lists a pre-seed SEIS fund with tickets of up to £250,000 and a seed fund at £1,000,000 to £3,000,000. Founders submit a pitch through a linked form. Sector focus and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage links a post on Deaku closing a £480k pre-seed round led by Fuel Ventures. The date is not shown on the homepage.
The homepage links a post on the UK AI startup raising $5.4M, a portfolio company. The date is not shown on the homepage.
